name: Alhaurín de la Torre (Spain)
description: Blue field with two yellow horizontal stripes, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alhaurín de la Torre (a tower on blue above two trees on yellow).
history: The flag is blue, with two yellow stripes and the arms of Alhaurín de la Torre drawn at the centre; the tower of Alhaurín is the emblem of the town, a monument in homage to the old medieval towers of the place.
